_comment: Arbitrum One USDG-vault deploy params. usd = Paxos USDG / Global Dollar on Arbitrum (native Paxos issuance, 6 decimals, non-rebasing; re-verify symbol + decimals on-chain before deploy). No WISE token on Arbitrum (zero). usdg forwards deposits to the worker (overhang-sweep) address: leave thirdParty zero (or equal to worker) — the deploy script enforces this and forces thirdParty = worker. worker: zero => deployer is used; set the production worker multisig before deploy. This chain launches DORMANT (active=false in the mesh manifest); note robinhood⇄arbitrum has no CCIP lane — bridge via Ethereum.
